text:
maria: heads-up — seeing an odd drop in tokens/sec from eu-west between 18:10-18:25, concurrent reqs steady but throughput down ~22%.
ashish: any packet loss or infra churn?
noah: ran a quick aggregate — p50 tokens/sec down 21%, GPU util down ~18% on affected racks.
lina: could be KV cache churn, TTL evictions spiked in the same window.
maria: pasting node snippet i grabbed:
```
node-43 eu-west-1 gpu_util=63% -> 49% tokens_per_sec=4200 -> 3200 tcp_retransmits=3.4 -> 12.1
```
ashish: hmm retransmits up on those hosts. k8s shows 2 pod restarts on node-43 around 18:12.
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-418 — https://redwood.air/inc/INC-2026-418
noah: quick forecast: if throughput stays down for 2 hours, packing efficiency drops and we burn ~8% extra reserved GPU hours.
maria: short-term mitigation: can we shift small-fill background workloads from eu-west to us-east to free packing headroom?
lina: we can, but need to confirm quantized model variants in us-east and watch multi-region egress costs.
ashish: I'll add a temporary autoscale rule to allow +10% burst in eu-west while we debug; pushing change now.
noah: rough cost for 2h at +10% capacity ~ $1.4k (reserved+spot mix) — acceptable for emergency.
maria: routing change applied, p50 tokens/sec starting to climb. monitoring looks better but still noisy.
ashish: root cause traced to a recent NIC firmware push in rack-7 that flipped jumbo frame handling, increasing retransmits.
lina: rolling back firmware on affected nodes now; kicking node drains for safe evict.
deploy-bot: rollback jobs started on nodes [node-41, node-43] — job ids: rollback-775, rollback-776
maria: after rollback, p50 tokens/sec recovered to baseline and gpu util normalized. marking INC resolved after validation.
noah: follow-up: adding a regression in the load simulator to inject retransmit noise and measure packing delta and tokens/sec sensitivity.
ashish: summary: network-induced retransmits caused KV miss churn -> lower tokens/sec and poorer packing -> temporary extra GPU hours. actions: firmware rollback, add sim regression, expose emergency routing knob in console.
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
